title: 第3章 恶灵骑士第4章 至尊法师
content_zh:
第3章恶灵骑士
“你以后会知道的。”
王南轩启动契约的力量，卡特·史雷身体里飞出一道暗淡无光，仿若由火焰组成的天使身影，那就是复仇之灵。
复仇之灵本是上帝的天使，受上帝之命来地球清理罪恶，后来，他们与恶魔两败俱伤，墨菲斯托偷走一部分重伤的复仇天使，将他们转为堕落的复仇之灵。
因为复仇之灵离体，老牛仔陷入极度的虚弱，他望着纠缠自己半生的复仇之灵，破口大骂道：“原来你长这样，真丑。”
复仇之灵很是恼火，想要挣扎，却根本摆脱不了王南轩的控制。
王南轩没有浪费时间，将复仇之灵收入自己体内，接着，他以地狱领主的力量强行抹去复仇之灵的意识。
王南轩闭上眼睛，片刻之后又睁开，双眼之中满是地狱烈火，这烈火很快蔓延他的全身，让他看起来如同一位火人。
不过，王南轩没像恶灵骑士那样变成骷髅头，他和那些恶灵骑士不同，他掌控着复仇之灵。
“很好。”
王南轩收起火焰，再次拿出黑心魔的雕像，手一挥，一道黑光从雕像中飞出没入史雷的身体，本来快死的老牛仔立刻恢复健康。
黑心魔气的几乎暴走：“又用我的力量？”
“老牛仔，珍惜最后一年的寿命，不要搀和太多事。”
王南轩打了个响指，史雷晕了过去，风魔冷声道：“领主，要不要我动手杀了他？这样不违反契约。”
“我没有失信的习惯，另外，他活着不是坏事，可以帮我们拖延恶灵骑士的时间。”
王南轩看了风魔一眼，冷冷说道，风魔尴尬一笑，不敢再多说什么。
想了想，王南轩拿出两团火焰交给土魔和水魔，吩咐道：“土魔，你带着火焰，走的越远越好，水魔，你去城里电视台找一个叫罗姗的女人，不要伤害她，等我命令。”
这是王南轩给自己留后路，如果接下来的战斗失败，这两团火焰会让他东山再起，无论如何，他都不能被彻底赶回地狱。
“是，领主。”
土魔和水魔虽然不明所以，但还是带着火焰快速离开，接着，王南轩朝风魔道：“风魔，带我去圣凡冈萨村。”

圣凡冈萨村是一个世代信仰上帝的村子，里面的村民全都是上帝的虔诚信徒，后来，墨菲斯托用永生承诺让他们自相残杀，最终，上千人全部死亡，连老人和小孩都不例外。
这些充满堕落之力的灵魂一直被困在圣凡冈萨村里，只要拿着圣凡冈萨契约，就能收取他们的灵魂，构建人间小地狱。
墨菲斯托本来快成功了，谁知，他派去收灵魂的卡特·史雷叛变，带着契约跑路，这才有现在这么多事。
“是，领主。”
风魔恭敬的说道，之前的恭敬，是因为畏惧，而现在，多了一份尊敬，这位领主的手段，真不是一般的厉害。
接着，风魔化成狂风在前面带路，王南轩紧随其后。
与此同时，附近的火箭城，一辆燃烧着烈焰，酷到没朋友的哈雷摩托车正在狂奔，身后一条笔直的火焰痕迹，十分耀眼。
content_en:
Chapter 3 Ghost Rider
"You'll find out later."
Wang Nanxuan activated the power of the contract, and a dim, light-like angelic figure made of flames flew out of Carter Shirey's body, which was the spirit of revenge.
The spirits of vengeance were originally angels of God, ordered by God to come to the earth to clean up evil. Later, they and the devil were both injured. Mephisto stole some of the seriously injured angels of vengeance and turned them into fallen spirits of vengeance.
Because the spirit of vengeance left his body, the old cowboy fell into extreme weakness. He looked at the spirit of vengeance that had been haunting him for half his life and cursed: "So you look like this, you are so ugly."
The spirit of vengeance was very angry and wanted to struggle, but could not escape Wang Nanxuan's control.
Wang Nanxuan wasted no time and took the Spirit of Vengeance into his body. Then, he used the power of the Hell Lord to forcibly erase the Spirit of Vengeance's consciousness.
Wang Nanxuan closed his eyes and opened them again after a moment. His eyes were filled with hell fire. The fire quickly spread throughout his body, making him look like a burning man.
However, Wang Nanxuan did not turn into a skull like the Ghost Riders. Unlike those Ghost Riders, he controlled the spirit of vengeance.
"Very good."
Wang Nanxuan put away the flame and took out the statue of the Black Heart Demon again. With a wave of his hand, a black light flew out of the statue and penetrated into Shi Lei's body. The old cowboy who was about to die immediately recovered to health.
The black-hearted demon almost went berserk: "Use my power again?"
"Old cowboy, cherish the last year of your life and don't get involved in too many things."
Wang Nanxuan snapped his fingers, and Shi Lei fainted. Feng Mo said coldly: "Lord, do you want me to kill him? This does not violate the contract."
"I don't have the habit of breaking promises. Besides, it's not a bad thing that he's alive. He can help us delay the Ghost Rider."
Wang Nanxuan glanced at Feng Mo and said coldly. Feng Mo smiled awkwardly and did not dare to say anything more.
After thinking about it, Wang Nanxuan took out two balls of flame and handed them to the Earth Demon and Water Demon, and ordered: "Earth Demon, take the flame with you and go as far as possible. Water Demon, go to the TV station in the city to find a woman named Luo Shan. Don't hurt her and wait for my order."
This is Wang Nanxuan leaving a way out for himself. If the next battle fails, these two flames will make him make a comeback. No matter what, he cannot be completely driven back to hell.
"Yes, Lord."
Although the earth demon and the water demon didn't understand why, they still left quickly with the flames. Then, Wang Nanxuan said to the wind demon: "Wind demon, take me to Shengfangansa Village."
The village of Santa Fangansa is a village that has believed in God for generations. All the villagers in it are devout believers in God. Later, Mephisto used the promise of eternal life to make them kill each other. In the end, thousands of people died, including the elderly and children.
These souls full of corrupted power have been trapped in the village of Saint Vangansa. As long as you hold the Saint Vangansa contract, you can collect their souls and build a small hell on earth.
Mephisto was about to succeed, but unexpectedly, Carter Shirey, whom he sent to collect souls, rebelled and ran away with the contract, which led to so many things happening now.
"Yes, Lord."
Feng Mo said respectfully. The previous respect was due to fear, but now, there is more respect. This lord's methods are really extraordinary.
Then, the wind demon turned into a strong wind and led the way, followed closely by Wang Nanxuan.
At the same time, in nearby Rocket City, a Harley-Davidson motorcycle, burning with flames and too cool to have friends, was running wildly, with a straight trail of flames behind it, which was very dazzling.
